description: This file acts as the server entry point, configuring server startup, listening on a specific port and host, and handling graceful shutdown upon termination signals.

methods.name: app.listen
methods.description: Starts the server listening on specified port and host.

methods.name: process.on
methods.description: Sets up an event handler for SIGTERM to initiate graceful shutdown.

methods.name: server.close
methods.description: Stops the server from accepting new connections and executes callback upon closure.

methods.name: console.log
methods.description: Outputs messages to the console for runtime information.

methods.name: process.exit
methods.description: Exits the Node.js process with the given code.

ctags.name: PORT
ctags.pattern: /^const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001; \/\/ Run on 3001 as required$/
